== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ウーハー</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-198o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズの開始時に、ウーハーと同じ位置カードにある武器とドロイドは、すべてロストする。カンティーナにいる場合、フェイズに関わらず、すべての武器とドロイドが即座にロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">無愛想で冷淡なバーテン。店内にブラスターとドロイドは御法度。「ドロイドに出す酒はねぇ。」ジャバ・ザ・ハットの専属バーテンになるため、彼には常に最高の飲み物を出す。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Wuher.

'''Card text:''' At the start of your control phase, all weapons and droids at Wuher's site are lost. At the Cantina, all weapons and droids there are lost immediately regardless of the phase.

'''Lore:''' An unfriendly, aloof bartender. Blasters and droids are forbidden in his establishment. “I don't serve drinks to droids.” He always serves Jabba the Hutt his finest drinks in hopes of becoming Jabba's personal bartender.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 3
* '''Power:''' 2
* '''Ability:''' 1
* '''Deploy:''' 2
* '''Forfeit:''' 3

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
